name: Hosur
registryAssessment: The official Krishnagiri District Revenue Administration page identifies Hosur as revenue taluk code 09 and lists its revenue villages; the official district Revenue Department directory identifies the Tahsildar Hosur and Revenue Divisional Officer Hosur. Tamil Nadu's official eAdangal service exposes survey/subdivision land-record lookup. This establishes local/state registry provenance, not open parcel-vector integration.
